description: What lanes the repo WANTS — the INTERPRET seam of onboard-v0. From a repo-scan signal, name candidate lanes (research, backend, frontend, infra, data, ml, content, etc.) with calibrated confidence + reasoning. Apoha: this is NOT a commitment; downstream seed-picker may take none, one, or many. Honesty bound: confidence is low when signal is thin.

input_refs.description: Reference to the repo-scan signal this inference is derived from.

lanes.description: Candidate lanes with confidence and reasoning. Ordered by confidence desc.

confidence.description: How strongly the repo-scan signals this lane.

reasoning.description: One-line justification grounded in the repo-scan (file types, manifests, frameworks).
